Fueling Deicing

Kopling geser bahan bakar

A safety device in fuel systems designed to disconnect or break under excessive force, preventing fuel spillage and system damage during abnormal events.

Definition

A safety device in fuel systems designed to disconnect or break under excessive force, preventing fuel spillage and system damage during abnormal events.

Operational example

Maintenance, inspect the fuel shear coupling after abnormal disconnect event during fueling to verify no fuel spillage.

Localized term
